questions.explanation: <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="5.579ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 2466 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D437" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D437"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(828,0)"><use data-c="1D441" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D441"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(1716,0)"><use data-c="1D434" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D434"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> consists of two polynucleotide chains, each chain forms a right handed spiral with ten bases in one turn of the spiral. The two chains coil to double helix and run in opposite direction held together by hydrogen bonding.
